## Motivation

Describe the problem and link a related issue if one exists.

## Changes

Describe the resulting behavior and any contract, migration, or documentation changes.

## Validation

List commands actually executed and their outcomes. Identify checks not run and why. Include sanitized desktop/mobile screenshots for visual changes.

## Risks and limitations

Describe compatibility, security, platform, rollout, or recovery concerns that a reviewer needs to assess. Distinguish implemented behavior from future milestone work.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and follows repository architecture/conventions.
- [ ] Relevant behavior has regressions and required checks pass.
- [ ] UI copy includes pt-BR, es, and en where applicable.
- [ ] Documentation is updated and secrets/generated artifacts are excluded.
